categories_thin: Financial and wealth advisers: almost every advisor office in North Brunswick turned out to be a branch of a national firm (Wells Fargo Advisors, J.P. Morgan/Chase, Citizens, Raymond James, TIAA, Cetera), so only one genuinely local independent RIA (Agile Wealth Management) survived the chain exclusion. More small RIAs are probably registered at North Brunswick addresses that do not surface in map or directory searches.

Title agencies: only one (Providence Abstract). NJ DOBI licenses title agencies by corporate entity, often at agent addresses; the DOBI title-company registry on nj.gov is the right bulk source but only PDFs were available and were not parsed.
Appraisers: only two found. NJ licensed-appraiser lookups are searchable one name at a time, so a township-wide census was not possible.
Architecture: only two firms. AIA New Jersey's find-an-architect tool is a form-based search that could not be queried without submitting a form.
Property management: three found, all residential or HOA; no commercial third-party management firm headquartered in the township surfaced.
Printing and photography were left to group D rather than duplicated here.
caveats: Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta, D&B, Cylex, LocalSolution, LocalityBiz, Firmania and Superpages were blocked: they returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare bot protection) both to direct fetches and to the Chrome browser session. Their content was reached only indirectly, through search-engine results that quoted or summarised those pages. Every entry sourced that way is marked 'one directory only' and should be treated as unverified until the triage team checks it.
Google Maps rendered only a five-result 'limited view' panel in this browser session and would not paginate on scroll, so map coverage here is a spot check rather than a census.
OpenStreetMap / Overpass API was unreachable (502 from overpass-api.de, 406 from the browser HTTP client), so no OSM cross-check was possible.

Brand-franchise handling: independently owned offices flying a national flag (Century 21 Burke Realty, Century 21 Gloria Zastko Realty, Real Property Management All-Star, CMIT Solutions, TeamLogic IT, Cetera) are included with a note rather than excluded, per the 'when unsure, include it' rule. Captive-brand insurance agencies (State Farm, Farmers, Allstate agents) and national bank or brokerage wealth branches were excluded as brand franchises.

Several entries carry a phone or address from a single directory and a second directory disagrees (Prime Tax, Jai Tax, Shuja Financial, Mid County Agency, Pavese McCormick). Each conflict is noted on the entry.

Kota Rajeswari CPA and Kiran CPA share a suite, and JT Financial Services LLC shares an address with a Jackson Hewitt storefront. Both pairs may be a single underlying practice, so dedupe at triage if confirmed.

Reachability of the zone: North Brunswick's land area lies entirely within about five miles of central Milltown, so every entry passes the 10-mile radius test. Two entries sit on or near the Milltown border (Oliver Youssef CPA on South Main Street, DNA Architects on Riva Avenue) and may belong to another zone; both are flagged in their notes.
data_gaps: No township-issued business licence list or business registry was located on northbrunswicknj.gov; the site's documents are procurement awards (architect, appraiser, financial adviser, IT support), not a business directory.
BBB North Brunswick category pages (information technology, web design, property management, employment agencies) are Cloudflare-blocked, so the accredited-business rosters there were not read.

Avvo, Justia, Super Lawyers and Lawyers.com North Brunswick attorney indexes were reached only through search summaries, not paged directly, so the count of solo attorneys in the township is certainly understated.

A number of listings give only a phone with no street address (Mangia Marketing, Transmedia Wave, BetaBulls, CAS AMIE, Mundra Appraisals, Medina Tech, SEO Consulting, Brunswick Properties). The triage team will need to call or look up the website to place them.
